Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare
We are looking for an experienced Medior Linux Engineer to join the Infrastructure Engineering & Support team. The role is focused on the design, engineering, operation, and support of enterprise Linux platforms running mission-critical workloads in regulated environments.
In addition to strong Linux system engineering skills, the role requires solid working knowledge of container platforms, particularly Kubernetes, to support modern, containerized workloads alongside traditional infrastructures.
The position sits within the Engineering (L3) function and includes participation in 24/7 on-call rotation, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and support for production GO-LIVE and major change activities.
 What you can expect from us
 Linux Engineering & Platform Design 
Design, build, and evolve enterprise Linux platforms in on-premises and/or cloud environments
Define and maintain standard OS builds, configurations, and engineering patterns
Ensure stability, availability, performance, and scalability of Linux systems
Support technology lifecycle management, upgrades, and obsolescence planning
 Container & Kubernetes Platforms 
Operate and support Kubernetes-based platforms with a focus on reliability and operational stability
Support containerized workloads running on Kubernetes in on-premises and/or cloud environments
Perform troubleshooting of container, pod, node, and networking issues
Collaborate with platform, middleware, and application teams on container onboarding and runtime requirements
Apply security best practices for containerized environments
 System Administration & Operations (L3) 
Provide L3 support for Linux and container platform-related incidents
Perform advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis in production environments
Support BAU / Run activities, including incident, problem, and change management
Participate in maintenance windows, patching cycles, and major infrastructure changes
 Security, Hardening & Compliance 
Perform Linux system hardening in line with internal security standards and industry best practices
Support security hardening and configuration validation for Kubernetes environments
Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements
Collaborate with Security and Audit teams during assessments and remediation activities
 Automation & Infrastructure as Code 
Design, implement, and maintain automation and Infrastructure as Code solutions
Use configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible
Contribute to Terraform or similar IaC frameworks
Support automation for OS provisioning, configuration, and container platform operations
 Performance, Monitoring & Capacity 
Monitor Linux and Kubernetes platform health, performance, and capacity
Identify performance bottlenecks and implement tuning and remediation actions
Support proactive capacity planning and availability risk identification
 Collaboration & Cross-Team Integration 
Collaborate with network, storage, middleware, security, and application teams
Support application onboarding on both VM-based and container-based platforms
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance reliability and operational efficiency
 What we expect from you
Strong hands-on experience as a Linux System Administrator / Engineer in enterprise environments
In-depth knowledge of enterprise Linux distributions (e.g. RHEL, Oracle Linux or equivalents)
Solid operational experience with Kubernetes platforms (cluster operations and troubleshooting)
Understanding of container concepts (Docker / OCI containers, images, registries)
Experience supporting mission-critical production systems
Proficiency with automation and configuration management tools (Ansible, Terraform or similar)
Solid scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar)
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills
 Preferred / Nice to Have 
Experience with high-availability or clustering solutions (Pacemaker, Corosync)
Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, Azure)
Familiarity with OpenShift or managed Kubernetes offerings
Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Experience working in regulated or audited environments
Relevant certifications (RHCE, CKA/CKAD or equivalent)

 Healthcare insurance ;

 About UniCredit Group
 UniCredit is a pan-European leading commercial bank providing best-in-class solutions and services across Italy, Germany, Austria, and Central and Eastern Europe. Our Vision is to be the Bank for Europe's Future. Our Purpose is to Empower Communities to Progress, delivering the best-in-class products and services for all stakeholders, unleashing the potential of our people and our clients across Europe. We serve over 20 million clients, supported by three Group product factories — Corporate, Individual and Payment Solutions — that ensure best-in-class expertise and scalable solutions across all markets. Our integrated model combines local proximity, deep client understanding and Group-wide capabilities, enabling seamless service and outstanding client experience. Digitalisation, operational excellence and a strong commitment to ESG principles underpin our journey, helping us deliver sustainable long-term value for clients, communities, employees and shareholders. Our shared Culture unites our people across all countries, empowering teamwork, driven execution and ambition through Ownership, Integrity and Caring.
